data.responsibility: Text, entities, graph, persistence, HTTP API and model proxy

truths.statement: POST /api/chat with body stream:true is handled by the HTTP server after private-route authentication and same-origin mutation checks, returning text/event-stream with no-store, X-Accel-Buffering:no and flushed JSON SSE events.

Chat upstream requests are OpenAI-compatible; non-stream requests remain buffered JSON responses, while stream requests send stream:true upstream and relay upstream SSE deltas incrementally as {type:"delta",text}, {type:"done"}, or sanitized {type:"error",error}.

Chat request validation rejects malformed messages, unsupported roles and bad numeric parameters before contacting upstream; upstream keys and raw upstream/internal errors are not returned to clients.

Production auth policy always uses Secure session cookies even if YANG_AUTH_SECURE_COOKIE=0; unsupported Transfer-Encoding and invalid Content-Length/body framing are rejected and the connection is closed.
Revision-based POST /api/sync validates and commits all changes atomically; stale revisions return 409 with no mutation.
GraphCache maintains exact incremental lexical results; aliases preserve source evidence. Optional semantic recall is explicit and disabled by default.
Public health cannot authorize private routes. Model keys are redacted from state and plain exports; encrypted export passwords use POST.

dont_assume: Do not expose model API keys or raw upstream error bodies.
Do not assume streaming routes may skip authentication or origin checks.

data.responsibility: Accessible idea workspace, offline storage, streaming and synchronization

truths.statement: API._postStream reads fetch ReadableStream bytes with TextDecoder streaming mode, handles split UTF-8 and SSE frame boundaries, parses JSON data frames, accumulates text, calls onText incrementally, and propagates AbortSignal.
The browser AI adapter sends stream:true only for non-JSON chat calls with onText, preserving JSON-mode and action-based model routing for ask/angle/collide/name/rewrite flows.
Existing ask/angle/collide and rewrite UI callbacks update visible prompt/redraft text as streaming deltas arrive; cancelling uses AbortController and does not persist partial generated questions.
Demo and private local storage namespaces are isolated. Private state loads only after session verification; logout clears rendered private content and preserves unsynced drafts.
Captured sync snapshots queue edits during requests and use a baseline/local/remote comparison for explicit conflict resolution.
Streaming truncation is an error. Blob exports, validated imports, editable graph settings and optional semantic recall are available.

dont_assume: Do not stream JSON-mode model calls unless the JSON parser path is redesigned.
Do not save a generated prompt until streaming completes and live.loading has been replaced with a final prompt.

data.responsibility: Business, protocol and integration regression coverage

truths.statement: tests/test_streaming.py uses ephemeral-port HTTP servers to prove the first downstream SSE delta arrives before a controlled upstream completion barrier is released.

Streaming regressions cover real server /api/chat SSE headers, upstream stream:true payloads, auth/origin rejection before upstream contact, invalid input, malformed upstream frames and sanitized upstream error frames.
Security regressions cover production Secure-cookie override hardening, unsupported Transfer-Encoding rejection, invalid Content-Length rejection and connection-close behavior after framing errors.
Required validation runners passed: project-tests reported 117 passed and 0 failed; web-syntax reported Web source syntax and top-level symbols passed.
128 Python tests passed including encrypted Python/JavaScript interoperability, sync atomicity, graph equivalence, security and upstream SSE.
Browser fixtures use synthetic credentials and a local mock model; actual real-model development is documented separately.
300/500-document store/API benchmark passed below 30% of full recomputation with exact output equality.

dont_assume: An incidental socket reset traceback during the connection-close regression is not a test failure when project-tests exits 0.
Do not count subagent isolated changes as applied unless explicitly accepted; the worker result was inspected and discarded in favor of parent-integrated changes.

Structured architecture, browser evidence and graph benchmark are in docs. Deployment status is tracked separately from development completion.

# T-003: Public deployment authentication and secret handling

The user explicitly authorized completing this project and deploying it at ideas.cafedaily.top. Implement and validate the backend prerequisites using the installed 0.2.1 harness. Do not deploy in this task.

Plan modules backend and qa; scope yang/auth.py, yang/server.py, yang/api.py, yang/store.py, yang/cli.py, tests/test_security.py. Kind feature, impact behavior. Acceptance criteria:

1. In production mode an absent/weak YANG_AUTH_TOKEN prev
acceptance: Production mode absent/weak YANG_AUTH_TOKEN prevents unsafe startup while loopback development and existing tests remain compatible.
Private API requests without valid bearer or signed HttpOnly session cookie return 401; GET /api/health remains public and redacted; GET /api/session, POST /api/login, POST /api/logout exist.

Login accepts JSON token only, throttles failures, issues expiring HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie; YANG_PUBLIC_ORIGIN governs same-origin mutation checks; production cookies are Secure; cross-origin cookie mutations fail while bearer clients work.

GET /api/state never returns model keys; state/config updates preserve keys by ID when omitted/blank and clear only with clear_key=true; keyConfigured metadata is present; import/export compatible and plain exports never leak keys.
Content-Length is validated and capped, socket timeout finite, client errors are generic, and static paths are contained via resolved path checks.
CLI default database location is outside source tree; explicit --db/YANG_DB still work; non-loopback bind without auth token refused unless unsafe development flag set; backend remains stdlib-only.

HTTP integration tests on ephemeral ports cover login, unauthorized reads/writes, cookie/bearer flows, origin rejection, model key redaction/preserve/clear, malformed lengths, and existing local behavior; project-tests and web-syntax pass.
A worker subagent handles a concrete subset; parent inspects and accepts output; backend and qa knowledge synchronized.

acceptance: POST /api/chat with stream=true forwards stream=true to selected OpenAI-compatible upstream and relays real SSE deltas as they arrive using event data objects for delta/done/error, with correct SSE headers and flushing; non-stream response remains compatible.

Private route authentication and same-origin checks run before streaming; invalid input is clearly rejected; upstream keys and raw internal error details are not exposed in stream or non-stream errors.

Frontend stream parsing handles split UTF-8 chunks/frames, accumulates text, invokes existing onText callbacks incrementally, passes AbortSignal, preserves action-based model routing and JSON-mode outputs, and current ask/angle/collide UI visibly updates while generated text arrives.
Cancelling generation aborts fetch, does not save a partial generated question, closes downstream/upstream responses, and avoids fake streaming by splitting a buffered answer.

Ephemeral-port HTTP tests prove first delta is received before a controlled upstream completion barrier is released; cover upstream errors and malformed frames; preserve current routing tests and web syntax checks.

Authentication regressions fixed: production cannot disable Secure cookies using YANG_AUTH_SECURE_COOKIE=0; unsupported Transfer-Encoding is rejected; invalid Content-Length/body framing errors close connections; focused regressions added.
Run project-tests and web-syntax via development_check, synchronize backend/frontend/qa knowledge, and finish with exact acceptance evidence.
